answer: Under EigenTrust-style scoring, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so identities must provide sustained honest service to retain influence. A freshly spawned sybil begins with negligible eigenvector centrality; without trusted, reciprocal interactions, it cannot gain enough transitive support to pass consensus. A lotus, bridge, or onyx label does not alter this: only accumulated, decay-resistant evidence from trusted peers can raise its score.
